newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to drift up, reaching for 110-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to drift up, reaching for 110-00.

text.p: September T-bond futures will drift higher on Tuesday, reaching first for the 110-00 level while backed up by positive chart signals, technical analysts said.
"We expect the market to go a little more on the upside here...and it should be held at the 110-00 level today," said Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International in London.
Above this she placed key resistance at 110-09.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell here, said the contract was likely to see short-term gains against a background of positive stochastics.
Miller said both the hourly and daily charts looked positive and pegged 110-22 as a major level to aim for.
By 0940 GMT, September T-bonds were up 3/32 at 109-27.

"Intraday stochastics and RSI all point to generally higher prices in the next few days, though the candlestick spinning top leaves risk for an attempt at 109-18 support," Miller said in a note to clients.
Further on the upside, beyond 110-22 she flagged 111-06, a 38.2 percent retracement of the slide from December 1996, as a level to watch.
On the downside, Liu said there was support at 109-15 and then 109-12, a low from Monday.
"This is strong support so if the market comes down through 109-12 it should come down quickly to 109-05 after that."
Miller placed immediate support at 109-25, followed by 109-11, a combination of high and low areas in mid-May.
By 1000 GMT, the September Eurodollar was unchanged from its prior close at 93.995.
